opus.problem: The BSB names Ebenezer in only three places (1 Samuel 4:1, 5:1, 7:12), so there are not 7 different facts about the word itself. Clues 1 to 4 stretch one verse into four clues by retelling the Aphek battle around 'Israel's camp at this place.' The rule says to swap the word for a spare when the Bible lacks 7 different facts.
Nearly repeats clue 3. Both say the ark of the covenant was brought from Shiloh to Israel's camp at this place; clue 4 only adds Hophni and Phinehas.
Not quite true to the verse. In 4:3 the elders only propose bringing the ark; in 4:4 it is 'the people' who send men to Shiloh. The clue says the elders sent.
